series.name: LUX-S-1600LG01 Micro Energy Storage System
series.notes: Combined lithium battery + inverter unit, 32 V battery, 60 A max charge current, max PV 95 V, MPPT 30 A. Table 8.10 codes 1-22; 14-20 and 22 could not be read from the source PDF. The manual's own troubleshooting chapter is explicit that many of these indications are normal protection behaviour, not a product fault - do not over-react to them.

meaning.en: Battery pack voltage is above the safe limit; output is cut.
meaning.ur: Battery pack ka voltage safe limit se upar hai; output band kar diya gaya hai.

causes.en: Charger overcharging a full pack
causes.ur: Poore pack ko charger zyada charge kar raha hai

causes.en: Cell imbalance in the pack so the highest cell hits the limit first
causes.ur: Pack mein cell imbalance hai, is liye sabse upar wala cell pehle limit par pohanch jata hai

solutions.en: Measure the pack voltage with a meter and compare it with the pack's maximum charge voltage.
solutions.ur: Meter se pack ka voltage measure karke pack ke max charge voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Switch off the charger/AC input and let the pack settle before restarting.
solutions.ur: Charger ya AC input band karke pack ko settle hone dein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Have cell voltages checked on the BMS; a single high cell needs balancing, not a charger change.
solutions.ur: BMS par cell voltages check karwayein; aik upar wala cell balancing chahta hai, charger badalne ki nahi.

source.title: LUX-S-1600LG01 Lithium Battery / Micro Energy Storage System User Guide (358-S010022-00B)

meaning.en: Battery pack voltage has dropped below the safe limit; output is cut.
meaning.ur: Battery pack ka voltage safe limit se neeche gir gaya hai; output band kar diya gaya hai.

causes.en: Pack deeply discharged during a long outage
causes.ur: Lambi outage mein pack gehri tarah discharge ho gaya

causes.en: PV not generating so the pack never recharges
causes.ur: PV se power nahi aa raha is liye pack recharge hi nahi hota

causes.en: Load connected exceeds what the small pack can supply
causes.ur: Lagaya hua load is chhote pack ke bajaye zyada hai

solutions.en: Measure the pack voltage with a meter at the DC terminals.
solutions.ur: DC terminals par meter se pack ka voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Recharge from PV or mains until the voltage is above the restart threshold on the LCD.
solutions.ur: PV ya mains se recharge karein jab tak voltage LCD ke restart threshold se upar na aa jaye.

solutions.en: Confirm the CAN cable between this unit and the inverter is seated, as the manual's troubleshooting says.
solutions.ur: Manual ke troubleshooting ke mutabiq confirm karein ke is unit aur inverter ke darmiyan CAN cable baithi hui hai.

source.title: LUX-S-1600LG01 Lithium Battery / Micro Energy Storage System User Guide (358-S010022-00B)

meaning.en: At least one cell in the pack is above the cell over-voltage limit.
meaning.ur: Pack mein kam az kam aik cell cell over-voltage limit se upar hai.

causes.en: One cell group in the pack has higher capacity than the rest
causes.ur: Pack mein aik cell group baqi se zyada capacity ka hai

causes.en: Cell imbalance left uncorrected for a long time
causes.ur: Cell imbalance lambi der tak theek na hua

causes.en: Pack temperature sensor reading low so charging was not derated
causes.ur: Pack temperature sensor kam dikha raha hai, is liye charging derate nahi hui

solutions.en: Read per-cell voltages from the BMS and identify which cell is high.
solutions.ur: BMS se har cell ka voltage padhein aur dekhein kaunsa cell upar hai.

solutions.en: Stop charging and let the pack discharge, then charge it fully so the BMS can balance the cells.
solutions.ur: Charging band karke pack discharge hone dein, phir use poora charge karein taake BMS cells balance kar sake.

solutions.en: If one cell stays high after balancing, that module must be replaced.
solutions.ur: Balancing ke baad bhi aik cell upar rahe to woh module replace karna hoga.

source.title: LUX-S-1600LG01 Lithium Battery / Micro Energy Storage System User Guide (358-S010022-00B)

meaning.en: At least one cell in the pack is below the cell under-voltage limit.
meaning.ur: Pack mein kam az kam aik cell cell under-voltage limit se neeche hai.

causes.en: One weak cell pulling the pack down
causes.ur: Aik kamzor cell pack ko neeche kheench raha hai

causes.en: Cell imbalance after a long float period
causes.ur: Lambi float period ke baad cell imbalance

causes.en: Pack capacity faded so the weakest cell reaches its limit early
causes.ur: Pack ki capacity fade ho gayi, is liye sabse kamzor cell jaldi limit par pohanch jata hai

solutions.en: Read per-cell voltages on the BMS and find the cell below the limit.
solutions.ur: BMS par har cell ka voltage padhein aur limit se neeche wala cell dhoondein.

solutions.en: Charge the pack fully and let the BMS run its balancing routine.
solutions.ur: Pack ko poora charge karein aur BMS ko apna balancing routine chalne dein.

solutions.en: Load-test the pack; a cell that collapses under load is a failed module, not a setting problem.
solutions.ur: Pack ka load test karein; load ke neeche girne wala cell kharab module hai, setting ki masla nahi.

source.title: LUX-S-1600LG01 Lithium Battery / Micro Energy Storage System User Guide (358-S010022-00B)

meaning.en: Charge current exceeded the safe limit; output is cut.
meaning.ur: Charge current safe limit se zyada ho gaya; output band kar diya gaya hai.

causes.en: Charge current limit configured above the pack rating
causes.ur: Charge current limit pack rating se upar configure hai

causes.en: Charger module failure drawing excess current
causes.ur: Charger module ki kharabi zyada current kheench rahi hai

causes.en: Battery cable shorted or terminals loose causing an arc
causes.ur: Battery cable short ho gaya ya terminals dhile hain, jis se arc ban raha hai

solutions.en: Set the charge current in the setup within the pack's rated maximum.
solutions.ur: Setup mein charge current pack ke rated maximum ke andar set karein.

solutions.en: Isolate the battery and inspect the cable and terminals for damage or looseness.
solutions.ur: Battery isolate karke cable aur terminals ko damage ya dhilapan ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: Measure actual charge current with a clamp meter and compare it with the setting.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se actual charge current measure karke setting se compare karein.

source.title: LUX-S-1600LG01 Lithium Battery / Micro Energy Storage System User Guide (358-S010022-00B)

meaning.en: Discharge current exceeded the safe limit; reduce the loads.
meaning.ur: Discharge current safe limit se zyada ho gaya; loads kam karein.

causes.en: Connected load bigger than this unit is rated for
causes.ur: Laga hua load is unit ki rating se bhaari hai

causes.en: Motor starting surge on a small pack
causes.ur: Chhote pack par motor ka starting surge

causes.en: Output short circuit on the load board
causes.ur: Load board par output short circuit

solutions.en: Reduce the loads: switch off appliances one at a time until the fault clears.
solutions.ur: Loads kam karein: appliances ko aik aik band karein jab tak fault na hat jaye.

solutions.en: Measure the output conductor with a clamp meter to see the actual discharge current.
solutions.ur: Output conductor par clamp meter se actual discharge current dekhein.

solutions.en: Check the load board for a short circuit before adding load back.
solutions.ur: Load wapas lagane se pehle load board mein short circuit check karein.

source.title: LUX-S-1600LG01 Lithium Battery / Micro Energy Storage System User Guide (358-S010022-00B)

aliases: Heat sink temperature is too high

meaning.en: The internal heat sink is above its temperature limit; output is cut.
meaning.ur: Internal heat sink apni temperature limit se upar hai; output band kar diya gaya hai.

causes.en: Heat sink blocked with dust
causes.ur: Heat sink dhool se block hai

causes.en: Unit installed in a closed cupboard with no airflow
causes.ur: Unit band almirah mein lagi hai jahan airflow nahi hai

causes.en: Internal fan failed
causes.ur: Internal fan kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate power and clean the heat sink with a soft dry brush or vacuum.
solutions.ur: Power isolate karke heat sink ko soft dry brush ya vacuum se saaf karein.

solutions.en: Check that the unit has open airflow on all sides and is not inside a sealed cupboard.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke unit charon taraf khul hawa pa rahi hai aur band almirah mein nahi hai.

solutions.en: Verify the internal fan spins freely and its connector is seated.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke internal fan azaad ghoomta hai aur uska connector baitha hai.

source.title: LUX-S-1600LG01 Lithium Battery / Micro Energy Storage System User Guide (358-S010022-00B)

aliases: Heat sink temperature is too low

meaning.en: The heat sink temperature is below the permitted range; output is cut.
meaning.ur: Heat sink ka temperature allowed range se neeche hai; output band kar diya gaya hai.

causes.en: Unit operated below its minimum ambient temperature
causes.ur: Unit apni minimum ambient temperature se neeche chalaya gaya

causes.en: Heat sink temperature sensor failed open
causes.ur: Heat sink temperature sensor open ho gaya

causes.en: Sensor connector disconnected, so the reading is implausible
causes.ur: Sensor connector nikal gaya, is liye reading ghayab haqeeqat ke mutabiq nahi hai

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature at the unit; it must be within the manual's operating range.
solutions.ur: Unit par ambient temperature measure karein; woh manual ke operating range mein hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Isolate power and measure the heat sink sensor resistance to see if it is open.
solutions.ur: Power isolate karke heat sink sensor ki resistance measure karein ke woh open hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Reseat or replace the temperature sensor; do not bypass the thermal cut-out.
solutions.ur: Temperature sensor dobara lagayein ya replace karein; thermal cut-out bypass na karein.

source.title: LUX-S-1600LG01 Lithium Battery / Micro Energy Storage System User Guide (358-S010022-00B)

meaning.en: A battery cell is above its temperature limit; output is cut.
meaning.ur: Battery ka aik cell apni temperature limit se upar hai; output band kar diya gaya hai.

causes.en: Direct sun or a hot room on the battery enclosure
causes.ur: Battery enclosure par seedhi dhoop ya garam kamra

causes.en: Cell temperature sensor reading high or failed
causes.ur: Cell temperature sensor ki reading high hai ya kharab hai

causes.en: Cell imbalance causing a hot cell under load
causes.ur: Cell imbalance ki wajah se load ke daurat aik cell garam ho raha hai

solutions.en: Measure cell temperature with a contact thermometer and compare with the BMS reading.
solutions.ur: Contact thermometer se cell temperature measure karke BMS reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: Keep the battery out of direct sun and away from heat sources, with ventilation around it.
solutions.ur: Battery ko seedhi dhoop se aur heat sources se door rakhein, aur aarpaar ventilation rahe.

solutions.en: Replace a failed cell temperature sensor with the correct part number.
solutions.ur: Kharab cell temperature sensor ko sahi part number se replace karein.

source.title: LUX-S-1600LG01 Lithium Battery / Micro Energy Storage System User Guide (358-S010022-00B)

meaning.en: A battery cell is below its permitted temperature; charging/discharging is blocked.
meaning.ur: Battery ka aik cell apni allowed temperature se neeche hai; charge/discharge block ho gaya.

causes.en: Unit operated in a very cold room or shed in winter
causes.ur: Unit sardi mein bohat thande kamre ya shed mein chalaya gaya

causes.en: Cell temperature sensor reading low or failed
causes.ur: Cell temperature sensor ki reading kam hai ya kharab hai

solutions.en: Measure cell temperature with a contact thermometer; allow the pack to warm up before charging.
solutions.ur: Contact thermometer se cell temperature measure karein; charging se pehle pack ko garam hone dein.

solutions.en: Keep the pack within its specified temperature range, away from outside walls in winter.
solutions.ur: Pack ko us ki specified temperature range mein rakhein, sarr mein deewar se door.

solutions.en: If the reading is implausible, reseat or replace the cell temperature sensor.
solutions.ur: Reading ghayab haqeeqat ke mutabiq na ho to cell temperature sensor dobara lagayein ya replace karein.

source.title: LUX-S-1600LG01 Lithium Battery / Micro Energy Storage System User Guide (358-S010022-00B)

meaning.en: PV1 input current is above the safe limit; output is cut.
meaning.ur: PV1 input current safe limit se upar hai; output band kar diya gaya hai.

causes.en: More panels in parallel on PV1 than the input is rated for
causes.ur: PV1 par input rating se zyada panels parallel lage hue hain

causes.en: Reflected sunlight off a neighbouring white wall raising current
causes.ur: Paas ki safed deewar se reflect hui dhoop current barha rahi hai

causes.en: PV1 current sensor fault
causes.ur: PV1 current sensor ki kharabi

solutions.en: Clamp-meter the PV1 string and compare it with the unit's max MPPT current (30 A for this unit).
solutions.ur: PV1 string par clamp meter lagayein aur usay unit ke max MPPT current (30 A) se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of panels in parallel on PV1 to within the input rating.
solutions.ur: PV1 par parallel panels ki kami karke input rating ke andar la dein.

solutions.en: Check the PV1 current sensor and its connector at the service centre if the reading is wrong with no load.
solutions.ur: Bina load par bhi reading ghalat ho to service centre par PV1 current sensor aur uska connector check karwayein.

source.title: LUX-S-1600LG01 Lithium Battery / Micro Energy Storage System User Guide (358-S010022-00B)

meaning.en: PV2 input current is above the safe limit; output is cut.
meaning.ur: PV2 input current safe limit se upar hai; output band kar diya gaya hai.

causes.en: More panels in parallel on PV2 than the input is rated for
causes.ur: PV2 par input rating se zyada panels parallel lage hue hain

causes.en: PV2 string current sensor fault
causes.ur: PV2 string current sensor ki kharabi

solutions.en: Clamp-meter the PV2 string and compare it with the unit's max MPPT current.
solutions.ur: PV2 string par clamp meter lagayein aur usay unit ke max MPPT current se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of panels in parallel on PV2 to within the input rating.
solutions.ur: PV2 par parallel panels ki kami karke input rating ke andar la dein.

solutions.en: Check the PV2 string fuse and connector for a fault before re-energising.
solutions.ur: Dobara chalu karne se pehle PV2 string fuse aur connector mein fault check karein.

source.title: LUX-S-1600LG01 Lithium Battery / Micro Energy Storage System User Guide (358-S010022-00B)

meaning.en: The output stage is drawing too much current; reduce the loads.
meaning.ur: Output stage bohat zyada current kheench raha hai; loads kam karein.

causes.en: Connected load bigger than the unit can supply
causes.ur: Laga hua load unit se zyada hai

causes.en: Output short circuit on the load board
causes.ur: Load board par output short circuit

causes.en: Inverter stage device with increased leakage
causes.ur: Inverter stage device ka leakage barh gaya

solutions.en: Reduce the loads until the fault clears, then note the total connected wattage.
solutions.ur: Fault hat jane tak loads kam karein, phir kul lagaya hua wattage note karein.

solutions.en: With power isolated, test the output wiring to earth to rule out a short.
solutions.ur: Power isolate karke output wiring ki earth ke saath continuity test karke short rule out karein.

solutions.en: If it trips with no load, have the inverter stage inspected at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Bina load ke trip ho to inverter stage ka muaina service centre par karwayein.

source.title: LUX-S-1600LG01 Lithium Battery / Micro Energy Storage System User Guide (358-S010022-00B)

title.ur: Fault 21 PV MOSFET short ho gaya

meaning.en: A short has been detected in the PV MOSFET stage; output is cut.
meaning.ur: PV MOSFET stage mein short detect hua hai; output band kar diya gaya hai.

causes.en: PV MOSFET device failed short
causes.ur: PV MOSFET device short ho kar kharab ho gaya

causes.en: PV string shorted to earth through damaged insulation
causes.ur: PV string ki insulation kharab hone se earth se short

solutions.en: Isolate PV at the DC isolator before any inspection; a shorted MOSFET is a fire risk.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi muaina karne se pehle DC isolator se PV isolate karein; shorted MOSFET aag ka khatra hai.

solutions.en: Megohmmeter-test the PV strings to earth to rule out an insulation short first.
solutions.ur: Pehle insulation short rule out karne ke liye PV strings ki earth ke khilaf megohmmeter test karein.

solutions.en: If the strings are clean, the MOSFET board needs replacement at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar strings theek hon to MOSFET board service centre par replace karna hoga.

source.title: LUX-S-1600LG01 Lithium Battery / Micro Energy Storage System User Guide (358-S010022-00B)
